title: workflow-gaps: run file written in Phase 8 before review phases collect all emittedSignals
description: The run file is written in Phase 8 (Metrics Recording) before Phases 7, 7a, 7b, and 7c run. Each review phase that emits signals must re-read and rewrite the run file to append entries to emittedSignals. In this run the file was rewritten twice after Phase 8. The Phase 8 initial write is structurally premature.
proposed_resolution: Move the run file write to after Phase 7c (Retrospective Review) in fix_signal.skill.md, collecting all emittedSignals from review phases first, then writing the complete run file once before the Cleanup Commit.
